title: [France] test_s1: shape, null rates, length distribution
headline: test_s1 France is 259,452 rows = 14.98% of the FILE and 15.31% of France. It is a MINORITY slice on both denominators and is structurally unlike the other 84.69% of France: 0.0000% empty addresses vs 2.5423% pooled, mean address length 50.07 vs 41.34 (+21.1%). Do not generalise s1 France figures to France. No defect found in the slice.
most_important_number_meaning: test_s1 share of France test rows: 259,452 / 1,694,445. Any row-level conclusion from this slice covers one row in seven.
defect_note: No defect. prefix_bad = 0/259,452, name_empty = 0/259,452, addr_empty = 0/259,452, len_hist sums to rows exactly. The finding is a MEASUREMENT-SCOPE discipline issue, already fleet policy, not a code defect.

s1_france_name_len_hist.bucket_semantics: key = len(business_name)//10*10 (build_profile.py:104-105). Bucket '0' = length 0-9, NOT 'empty'. name_empty=0 so no row in this bucket is actually empty.
s1_france_name_len_hist.note: 94.44% of names in 10-29 chars; only 0.028% exceed 39 chars. s2 reaches 60-69, s3 reaches 70-79.

s1_bias_vs_pooled.addr_empty_rate_note: s1 is exactly 0.0000%, so the relative error is undefined - no weighting recovers pooled 2.5423% from s1 data.

sample_sufficiency.verdict: Precision is NOT the binding constraint; population choice is. Bias is ~100x the sampling noise.

geography_density_rederived.method: region discriminators = hauts+nouvelle+pays; dept discriminators = nord+gironde+calais+atlantique; from addr_tokens['France']. Independently recomputed, not quoted from D128.
geography_density_rederived.density_definition: token occurrences / France rows. Exceeds 100% for s1 because a region name contributes 2-3 tokens per row. This is a CONCENTRATION INDICATOR, NEVER A ROW COUNT.
geography_density_rederived.d128_discrepancy: My densities differ slightly from D128's (100.7/6.8/32.6/38.7) because my discriminator token sets are fixed 3-region/4-dept; D128's exact membership is unpublished. Qualitative conclusion identical.
geography_density_rederived.could_not_reproduce_retracted_arithmetic: 101,521 + 85,197 + 72,734 = 259,452 (the retracted figure). My measured s1 values are hauts 101,717, nouvelle 85,311, pays 72,812 = 259,840, close to but NOT equal to the s1 row count. Conclusion survives regardless.

entity_id_prefix_check.extended_to_all_six_profiles: prefix_bad = 0 in every country of every file (train s1/s2/s3 and test s1/s2/s3)
entity_id_prefix_check.semantic_correction: The check tests S{src}- where src is the SOURCE number and is applied IDENTICALLY to train and test. So prefix_bad=0 in train_s1 means train entity_ids ALSO start with 'S1-'. THE S PREFIX ENCODES SOURCE, NOT SPLIT. It is not a train/test discriminator.
entity_id_prefix_check.downstream_consumer: stage2.py:106 -> pl.when(pl.col('entity_id').str.starts_with('S2')).then(2).otherwise(3). Applied to the q (S2+S3) side, not s1. A malformed prefix would silently fall into otherwise(3) rather than raise. Measured: no such rows exist.
entity_id_prefix_check.gap: No entity_id values are stored in the profile, so suffix format, uniqueness and cross-file disjointness are NOT checkable. Not estimated.

structural_finding_s1_is_the_answer_key_.claim: s1 is not a random sample of France - it is a different ROLE. s1 = candidate/answer-key side; s2+s3 = query side.
evidence: features.py:1 - 'Pairwise feature computation for (query = Source2/3 record, candidate = Source1 record).'
make_submission.py:66 - s1 entity_id aliased to source1_entity_id
structural_finding_s1_is_the_answer_key_.consequence: s1 France is 100% of the SCORED French units, while being 15.31% of French ROWS. Both statements are true; they are different populations.
structural_finding_s1_is_the_answer_key_.disagrees_with_work_order: My order asks me to assert that conclusions generalise to 'only 15.31% of French rows'. That is CORRECT for row-level descriptive statistics (proved by the bias table) but WRONG as a coverage/participation claim. Asserting it as coverage would itself be a scoping error of the same kind that produced the retracted figure.

france_is_test_only.consequence: No French training data exists. No French train/test consistency check is available and s1 cannot be calibrated against French labels. Consistent with P013/P014/P015, all of which found the France train slices empty.

whole_file_property_test_s1.detail: US 663,106/663,106; India 809,986/809,986; France 259,452/259,452. test_s1 has ZERO empty addresses and ZERO comma-free addresses in ALL THREE countries - it is a pre-normalised, fully-populated file. test_s2/s3 are not.

gaps: No entity_id values stored - prefix confirmed, suffix/uniqueness/disjointness not checkable.
len_hist is NAME length only (build_profile.py:104, on bn). There is NO address-length histogram in the profile, only the mean. An address-length DISTRIBUTION claim would be a gap.
No per-row data - all figures are aggregates or token-occurrence sums.
name_tokens/addr_tokens are TOP 4000 per country (min values 23/58/60 for test s1/s2/s3 France). A missing token is 'not in the top 4000', NEVER 'does not occur'.
build_profile.py:126-127 FLATTENS comma components - no per-component rate (e.g. share of rows with N components) is derivable.
The profile does not strip accents; the pipeline does (normalize.py:317). Accented-token counts here are undercounts.
No downstream/pipeline-visible effect claimed for the length and empty-address statistics. Only the entity_id prefix was traced to a consuming code path (stage2.py:106).

recommendations.text: No defect in this slice. prefix_bad 0/259,452; name_empty 0/259,452; addr_empty 0/259,452; len_hist closes on rows. Nothing to fix.
Do not quote any s1-France statistic as a France statistic. Biases run 2.5-21% and the empty-address bias is unbounded because s1's value is exactly zero.
France is test-only. No French training data exists, so no French train/test consistency check is available.

Add a population tag to every France figure: every France number carries its denominator (test_s1 France / France test / France scored units). These are genuinely different quantities and the project already shipped one wrong figure from conflating two of them.

If a French length/null profile is ever needed for tuning, it must come from s2+s3 (1,434,993 rows), not s1 - s1 has no long-name tail and no empty addresses. NOT shown that any current hyperparameter was fitted on s1 France; that would need the training logs.
